name: GeminiBot A1
summary: GeminiBot A1 is a wheeled humanoid robot designed by Gemini for industrial work. It combines an articulated humanoid upper body and dexterous hands with a mobile wheeled base. The manufacturer describes binocular vision, laser and visual navigation, and a control architecture that pairs industrial motion control with AI task decisions. Its industrial components are intended for sustained work and precision manipulation. The product is publicly documented; present delivery availability has not been verified.
